notes: The unit may be a counterfeit, so its parts may not match a genuine one.

gaps: The charge IC identification is the author's reading of the topmark.
method: One teardown blog post of a rechargeable pen the author calls a Hyde Edge Recharge.
Cell, charge IC, LEDs, pressure sensor and heater are described.

comps.spec: 600 mA·hr lithium cell per the author; recharged over USB Micro-B (author measured 406 mA·hr going in)
SOT23 IC, topmark LTH7, identified by the author as an LTC4054-4.2 standalone charge controller
Two LEDs, red during charge and white during each puff
Pressure sensor under a black felt disk, activates the coil on each puff
Heater coil in the draw tube, fed by two red wires

sources.title: Teardown of a Hyde Edge Recharge vape pen (softsolder.com blog)
